book.title: Yon Dowan Weng Olo Yone Dolanebuotabe.

content: Yesuse okok sumo mikiktemo nase otabe.

Amo asu blimanoa Galili temano Kena bib ye naka make alelo omamabe kesoa i Yesus esa e awok osa e okok aleyemin naka isa weng omfubeniba baabeniba Ibo tliba falo ga wembianoba nakae alelo omeko geibbua tliba imen baka waen aay bakao wembianiba
waen aayo blimano kesoa Yesuse awoko baabanoa Waen aayo blimanobo ge baabasoa
e baabonea Ob bobol temo fumbebo E daabeneko ge fumbeb otane ne titilo nakaia unangai alebenamabio amo mo tam tlutneim blim biobo gesea
e biemo okok nakai baabenoa E baanea Inamin namino inaine gene mole ibo ele weng baaneme iwat namine ge baabesobe.

Amo gosake tom keto beselibo asuke asuke asuke nao olanea Yudai ili hekmel kukubo wafunom gaibo i kweil aayo fuba bianiba eka fleto fuba biam nine geneta olanebiotabe. Okok nakai aangket olo temo elekiem elekieme aangket gwabo odi oleb teniba ibumino 10 genimib ota utlamabobe.
Yesuse okok nakai baabenea Ibo aayo dowon teniba tom aangket olo ibaboine ge baabesea i inaniba aayo dowon teniba ibaiba sibbesoa
e baabenea Aangket gwabo mo oboniba aay ele obdi obeb moniba falo kima bie nakae obaline gesea i inaniba obdi obeb moniba obansiba

dowon temea aaye deskinanea waen aay anea eka aangket sum otem osa alukum inasobe. Okok naka eli aaye ele dowon tlibbue tekein kebib otane e mo tekein kebeba kesoa e funanea Waen aay ele gam ayamobe. Fatda obdi obeb tlibe? ge funanea

nakae alelo omamabe baabanea Nakai alukum waen aayo gam ayamo sin kiki dowoniba nakai gabam tol temo mima fubesota waen aayo gam misiamo mit kikita dowonabib otane kobole waen aayo gam ayamo deibo bineba Abuk kiki dowonine gabeobo ge baabasebe.
Yesuse e okok sum olo mikiktemo Galili temano Kena bib ye klanea e titilo alebenea wateniba e okok aleyemin nakai e bainobo gesiobe.
Yesuse monea Gode am sumo tem tamo nakai inamin namino webibi fotebesebe.
Olo inabibo blimanoa Yesus esa e awok osa e ningwal isa eka e okok aleyemin naka isa i moniba Kabaneam bib ye bliba amo milim mak blimansobe.
Yudai singkalin am sumo i Fasoba imeno dowonabib amo dikib tebiota Yesuse ulaneta Yelusalem bib onsebe.

E utnea Yelusalem bib ut unanea tanea Gode am sumo daam tem tam unanea temea naka maki am yo temo makob imen wemin baan dim omfa bianiba eil blumakaua eil sibsiba wana i dleb teniba toubiba naka maki teniba walo dleb mo funiba Gode heitdahabiba eka mak ile tebol dim ye toula bliba naka maki skeim da tlebibi Lom monio oleb teniba oyeniba Islel monio oise une biam blib kesoa yatenea
atliaubasoa sayo tebelonea eital dabanea tobonea biou biou yemdenea alukum naka isa eil sibsib isa eil blumakau isa fotebenea uniba eka monio biino delabmabenea monio dilbi daaknoa biin daak unoa
eka wani webib nakai baabenea Dleb onon tlaine! Ibo ne Aye am olo temo webiba makob imen wemin baan dim ano kesoa deibueine ge baabesebe.
E inasea e okok aleyemin nakai ateniba funaniba E weng sango Gode buk temo baanoa

content.text: God kobo ne keb amo talowabia i ne nenanom genabiobo genobio

content: yamo balinobo ge funasiobe.
Yudai komokwali e inaneo wateniba baabaniba Kobo waneta baabkeseta naebe? Kobo okoko sumo mo klaneba ni katenoba tekein kenoba waneta baabkeneta inanale geseta naebobe genomo gesiba
Yesuse baabenea Ibo Gode am sum olo galafanimibo ne amo asumatna kenia imin genamabibo ge baabesea
i baabaniba Nakai Gode am sum olo geibbuei gembiba bifolo 46 blimanota geibbio otane kobo fatnanebta Ne amo asumatna kenita imin genamabibo gabebe? gesib
otane Yesuse Gode am sumo weng sango inangge baabese olo Gode am sum okobbabe. Ele dim touneta baasebe. Sinanomo e anaiba kaanea amo asu kenea make dime imin hananamabeo saa weng ota baabesebe.

E inangge baanebua sinanoa e atdimo anaiba kaanea amo asu kenea make dime imin hana tlea e okok aleyemin nakai funaniba E sino inangge baanebiotabo ge funaniba Gode buk tem weng osa eka Yesuse wengo oye bine osa bainobo gesiobe.
Fasoba imen unalin am bomabua Yesuse Yelusalem bib ye bianea e inamin namin okok sumo klabea nakaia unangai homoni e bainobo gesiobe.
Ina otane Yesuse emalole i wengo mo bainobo geim blimobe. Niminbabe, e nakai alukum i kukubo tekein kenea i bobol temo klao mo bainobo gabibba kesotabe.
Naka maki Yesuse baabaniba Nakai bobol temo inangge fumbiobo ge baabanamini blimobe. Niminbabe, e nakai bobol temo sin tekein kebebe.
